title: Truncated variants of thyroid hormone receptor beta display disease-inflicting malfunctioning at cellular level.
authors: Rehman, Ghausiya; Kashyap, Jyoti; Srivastav, Amit Kumar; Rizvi, Sheeba; Kumar, Umesh; Tyagi, Rakesh K
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和细胞实验研究甲状腺激素受体β截短变体的结构稳定性、配体结合及染色质互作，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作（受体-染色质）且含MD方法，但非典型TF-DNA结合位点预测或界面建模，故评6分。
abstract: Thyroid hormone receptor beta (THRbeta) is a member of the nuclear receptor superfamily of ligand-modulated transcription factors. Upon ligand binding, THRbeta sequentially recruits the components of transcriptional machinery to modulate target gene expression. In addition to regulating diverse physiological processes, THRbeta plays a crucial role in hypothalamus-pituitary-thyroid axis feedback regulation. Anomalies in THRbeta gene/protein structure are associated with onset of diverse disease states. In this study, we investigated disease-inflicting truncated variants of THRbeta using in-silico analysis and cell-based assays. We examined the THRbeta truncated variants on multiple test parameters, including subcellular localization, ligand-receptor interactions, transcriptional functions, interaction with heterodimeric partner RXR, and receptor-chromatin interactions. Moreover, molecular dynamic simulation approaches predicted that shortened THRbeta-LBD due to point mutations contributes proportionally to the loss of structural integrity and receptor stability. Deviant subcellular localization and compromised transcriptional function were apparent with these truncated variants. Present study shows that 'mitotic bookmarking' property of some THRbeta variants is also affected. The study highlights that structural and conformational attributes of THRbeta are necessary for normal receptor functioning, and any deviations may contribute to the underlying cause of the inflicted diseases. We anticipate that insights derived herein may contribute to improved mechanistic understanding to assess disease predisposition.
abstract_zh: 甲状腺激素受体β（THRbeta）是核受体超家族中配体调节转录因子的一员。配体结合后，THRbeta依次招募转录机制组分以调节靶基因表达。除调控多种生理过程外，THRbeta在下丘脑-垂体-甲状腺轴反馈调节中发挥关键作用。THRbeta基因/蛋白质结构的异常与多种疾病状态的发生相关。在本研究中，我们利用计算机模拟分析和细胞实验探讨了致病性THRbeta截短变体。我们从多个测试参数检查了THRbeta截短变体，包括亚细胞定位、配体-受体相互作用、转录功能、与异二聚体伙伴RXR的相互作用以及受体-染色质相互作用。此外，分子动力学模拟方法预测，由点突变导致的THRbeta-LBD缩短对结构完整性和受体稳定性的丧失有相应贡献。这些截短变体表现出异常的亚细胞定位和受损的转录功能。本研究表明，某些THRbeta变体的“有丝分裂书签”特性也受到影响。该研究强调，THRbeta的结构和构象属性对正常受体功能是必需的，任何偏差都可能促成所引发疾病的潜在原因。我们预期，由此获得的见解可能有助于提高对疾病易感性评估的机制理解。
